anomalies.observed: The MCU main supply pins are not connected to a power net: FCC2 VDD pins 11/27/50/75/100 and NAVC2 VDD pins 19/32/48/64 are each on auto-generated unconnected nets. NAVC2 VSS pins 18 and 63 are tied together only, not to GND. The +3V3 net that carries MCU decoupling caps, pullups, VBAT and connector power is not connected to REG1 output +3.3V.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the LD39200PU33R 3V3 rail feeds both MCUs and sensors, so FCC2/NAVC2 VDD pins should be connected to the regulated 3V3 rail and VSS pins to GND.
anomalies.impact: Both MCUs are effectively unpowered/ungrounded; the board cannot boot or perform its intended flight-control/navigation function.

anomalies.observed: The 25 MHz HSE crystals are not connected to the MCU HSE oscillator pins. FCC HSE3 pin 1 connects to FCC2 PE6 and pin 3 connects through R13 to FCC2 PE7, while FCC2 PH0 is only loaded by C1 and PH1 is on the VREF+_FCC net. NAVC HSE1 is connected only to C28/C46/R67 and not to NAVC2 PH0/PH1.
anomalies.expected: For STM32H753VITx and STM32F405RGTx, the external high-speed crystal should be connected to the HSE oscillator pins PH0/PH1, as stated in the specification.
anomalies.impact: The intended external 25 MHz HSE clock is unavailable to both MCUs; the board may fail to start or may fall back to an internal oscillator if software permits.

anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no otter_CH330 UART-to-USB converter components. Several USB data paths terminate in unconnected or single-node nets: USB1/USB3 D+/D- are unconnected, and USB4 D+/D-/ID pass through resistors into nets with only one node.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists two CH330 UART-to-USB converters in the Connections sheet for programming/debug UART-to-USB paths.
anomalies.impact: The intended UART-to-USB programming/debug interfaces are absent or incomplete, changing the board's interface behavior relative to the specification.

parsed.summary: Anomaly detected: the netlist leaves the MCU power/ground and HSE oscillator connections open or miswired, and it omits the specified CH330 USB-UART bridges, so the board cannot behave as described in the Hades design specification.
